from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess
p=Path('analysis')
cmd=['go','test','-race','-count=3','-timeout=30s','-json','-overlay','analysis/overlay.json','-run','^TestIdentity','.']
with (p/'probe-attempt-01.stdout.jsonl').open('xb') as out, (p/'probe-attempt-01.stderr.log').open('xb') as err:
 r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=out,stderr=err)
events=[]
for line in (p/'probe-attempt-01.stdout.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
 try: events.append(json.loads(line))
 except ValueError: pass
starts=[e['Test'] for e in events if e.get('Action')=='run' and e.get('Test','').startswith('TestIdentity') and '/' not in e['Test']]
print('exit=',r.returncode,'discovered=',len(set(starts)),'starts=',len(starts),'test_passes=',sum(e.get('Action')=='pass' and bool(e.get('Test')) for e in events))
print('failures=',[e.get('Test','package') for e in events if e.get('Action')=='fail'])
raise SystemExit(r.returncode if r.returncode else int(not starts))
